node.title: Price regular anchors by their child image degrees
node.statement: For a full-gcd1 shared carrier V of dimension4 and degree D=nu*d, a pencil-free dimension5 pair enclosure W with full generic projection, and N>=A>D, actual pairs of fixed original weight at most c and complete cores at least A satisfy Omega<=c*((N-D)*b0+D*T)/(A-D). Here b0 bounds every birational regular child, C_eta bounds image-degree-eta children, and T=max(eta-1)*(C_eta-b0)_+. Characteristic0 or p>d is required; all child bounds are finite nonnegative actual-subset bounds.
